items.source: This is a simplified, opinionated implementation of an LRU cache for internal use in Spring Framework. It is inspired from ConcurrentLinkedHashMap.
items.translation: 这是为 Spring Framework 内部使用而实现的简化版 LRU 缓存，其设计灵感来源于 ConcurrentLinkedHashMap。

items.source:
Read and write operations are internally recorded in dedicated buffers,
then drained at chosen times to avoid contention.
items.translation: 读写操作在内部记录于专用缓冲区中，然后在选定的时间进行排空以避免竞争。

items.translation: 立即删除给定的键及其关联的值。
